2459-3899-5006-8170.description:

Repeat.

789-4279-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-4279-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2577-6763-7084-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-6763-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7705-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-7705-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2292-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-7936--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

728-4681-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.
624-2777-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

If Phyrexian Devourer's power becomes seven or greater this way, it triggers.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1 until you have an empty library.
Resolve the first Phyrexian Devourer trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Devourer leaves the battlefield, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Hallar equal to the number Phyrexian Devourer had.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.

2724-3987-7843.description:
Activate Elrond by paying {5}{U}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

465-670-1619-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6150.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from exile to the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

7124-7653-7769.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
7124-7653-7769.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker, triggering the ability given to it by Pip-Boy 3000, untapping all lands you control.

The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and then untapping it and causing you to gain an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

856-997-4321-6277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-997-4321-6277.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

465-3175-6797.description:

When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

654-2893-3875-6168.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.

Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

876-4763-5004-6068.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Cathodion.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Cathodion, targeting Koll.
When Cathodion dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Cathodion by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4125-5195-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser

Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Shipwreck Dowser
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

359-372-2493.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-2493.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.

2146-3682-4518-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-2248-3147-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Skyshroud Ranger.
Skyshroud Ranger does not have summoning sickness.
654-2248-3147-3525.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.

Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.

Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

Cast Kite Shield.
